content: RRF: k is the smoothing knob (low k = trust top ranks, high k = skeptical); common default 60, tuned range 30-50 when channels are strong/similar. Key failure mode: fusing correlated rankers (e.g. multiple BM25 variants) buys almost nothing - RRF pays off when rankers fail in DIFFERENT ways (dense vs lexical). Weighted RRF sum(w_r/(k+rank)) is the standard remedy when one channel is clearly stronger. Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/Azure AI Search all implement RRF with per-channel weights.
